author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಓರೆಕೋರೆಯು ಮರೆಯು ಸಾಧನೆಯು ಬೆನ್ನಿಗಿರೆ 
ತೋರಿಕೆಯ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ನಿನಗೆಂದು ಶತ್ರು
ಆರಿಸಿರೆ ವಿಧಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಅನುಕ್ರಮವನುಸರಿಸೆ
ಸಾರಿಹೇಳುವೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Crookedness and bias are hidden when achievement is behind you;
show-off study is your enemy forever;
if you choose the proper method and follow the right sequence,
you will proclaim knowledge, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Real achievement covers small flaws; superficial study is a lifelong enemy. Learn methodically and in proper order, and you will be able to teach what you know.
